thread:
sam: Heads up — small change window tonight 23:00-23:30 UTC. Planning a split-wave: API + Router first, then Runtime + Console. Need pin order and rollback plan. Any objections?

 tanya: ack. foggy on the router header-swap timing. Can we push router to second wave?

 leo: prefer router with API to avoid a double routing layer mismatch. If we move router later we need a compatibility shim (~10m work).

 sam: shim is possible but increases risk. Proposed order: 1) API (v2.4.1) pin, 2) Router (v1.9.0) pin, 3) Runtime (kernel batching toggle), 4) Console (schema rollout). Rollback sketch: unpin router -> shift traffic back to legacy-router pool -> unpin API if issues persist.

 dave: +1 on order. Please add to release notes: runtime kernel flag flip and KV eviction TTL change. Ops to watch p50/p95 for /v1/generate and metric :router_hdr_swap.

 deploybot: DeployBot: preflight checks passed.
 - pinned versions: API=2.4.1, Router=1.9.0
 - quiet window reserved: 23:00-23:30 UTC

 tanya: can someone run a quick staging smoke for router header negotiation? quick curl test: 
 ```
 curl -X POST https://staging-router.redwood.internal/test -H 'x-router-hdr: v2' -d '{"ping":1}'
 ```

 leo: i'll run that after 22:30 and post results.

 dave: operational trigger: if latency spike >50% for >5m, execute rollback: manual split -> legacy-router pool, then API unpin. who will execute? leo?

 leo: i'll be oncall tonight and will execute if needed.

 sam: cool. i'll update the deploy manifest with the pins and set a 10% canary for the API for the first 5m. forward release notes to #release-notes and tag @eng-sre for pre-check.

 deploybot: DeployBot: canary started: API v2.4.1 -> 10% traffic. Monitoring: p95=120ms, errors=0.

 sam: :thumbsup:

 tanya: noted, i'll watch console errors and schema warnings.

 deploybot: DeployBot: canary progressed to 50% after 6m. Metrics stable.

 sam: proceed to router pin and traffic shift to 30%.
